accepted_limitations: Body width is apparent segmented-mask width and is not PSF-corrected physical chromatin width
Below-2-um tracks can represent genuine short nuclei, optical tips, split fragments, or noise and remain subject to automated specimen-level sensitivity reporting
Repeated 2D ROIs support sampled area and slab-volume normalization but not anatomical seminal-vesicle volume
The retained one-specimen-per-group pilot validates execution and provenance only and does not establish a biological group effect
required_follow_up: Preserve the production profile, checkpoint, evidence archive, and RC7 audit unchanged
Obtain explicit user authorization before push, merge, final tag creation, or publication
